harmonic_references.provenance: Report physical page7 Table3 and original deformation image
Report physical page7 Table3 and original stress image

limitations: No original WBPZ/RST/full Mechanical setup found. Original FEM contours and source tables are references only.
Reported mesh 184374 nodes/93476 SOLID187 elements; material AISI4130 and 1000N harmonic excitation are reported assumptions, not independently replayed.
Mode5 table lists17.332Hz, source ANSYS screenshot title says TotalDeformation6 at17.332Hz. Mode index mapping requires review.
Modal deformation magnitudes are normalization-dependent and must not be treated as physical static displacement targets.
Fatigue claim of10^-32seconds is not accepted as physical life or crack-initiation ground truth. No raw life calculation or S-N validation found.
Native SolidWorks file remains opaque to this inspection; no independent geometry-validity claim.
